name: tuned
based_on: the default config's patent-example variables, plus Exact variables for the single-valued ids (LinkedIn, GitHub) from dedupe's variable definitions page, a larger labelling budget, and a partition threshold chosen on the held-out world
tuning: Variables, labelling budget and threshold were chosen by looking only at the held-out world (seed 20261118); the oracle labels only held-out pairs; the threshold maximises held-out pairwise F1
proposed_note: none: dedupe's partition() has one threshold and no review band
